newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil declines, premiums unchanged.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil declines, premiums unchanged.

text.p: NWE gas oil fell with benchmark IPE futures on Tuesday but premiums held steady on a second consecutive day of lethargic physical business, traders said.
NWE gas oil futures finished down $3.75 at $223.00 on the nearby November contract after downard pressure on Brent added to strong selling of NYMEX gasoline.

Some traders, pointing to firm barge premiums as a harbinger of stronger fundamentals, said recent good supply of low sulphur diesel from arbitrage cargoes from the U.S. and Mediterranean was steadily finding homes and premiums were set to perk up.
"I think firmness is going to come very soon because barges are strong and they were strong on Friday," one trader said.
But others said a bid by refiners to maximise low sulphur diesel production by using all available jet fuel and heating oil put pressure on diesel premiums and supported heating oil.
Heating oil cargoes were unchanged at Nov IPE +$4/5. Low sulphur diesel was discussed around Nov IPE +$22/24.
On the barge market, diesel winter grade was Nov IPE +$32/33. Heating oil refinery grade barges were traded at Nov IPE +$1.00 and 1.50.
